svg.title: GEL RAM public readout
svg.desc: Two separate demonstrations. A canonical Q8 record has four equivalent views with a shared score. A source catalog returns a pinned quotation and rejects changed bytes. No private encoder or connection between the demonstrations is implied.

g.text: Public Rust preview · inspect the data, run the checks
Change phase, activity mask and noise
FOUR EQUIVALENT VIEWS · ONE SHARED SCORE
Independent reference checks + exact inverse checks
Not four unrelated files, answers or confidence votes
SEPARATE SOURCE DEMO: title → quote → source → integrity gate
Changed bytes + original trusted pins → REJECTED. Integrity is not a proof of factual truth.
Architecture illustration, not a screenshot or physical RAM circuit. No private data.
